svg.title: US222 — Alerts for aircraft due for scheduled maintenance (manual trigger)

g.text: US222 — Alerts for aircraft due for scheduled maintenance (manual trigger)
[each aircraft not INACTIVE × periodic template applicable to its model (no ongoing record)]
FlightHoursCriterion: hours since last completion >= interval.flightHours
(+ X-Partial-Response: true if any source was incomplete)
Computed on demand from every replica and not stored (conversation 016: the check is triggered
manually), so all replicas give the same answer and no duplicate alerts are created.
